normalization: Fixed unsteered Who are you? prompt median residual norm, first token excluded; original effective MLP write column including learned gain. Same edit magnitude across all prompts.
sampler: Inverse-CDF from full-vocabulary float32 softmax; independent Python random.Random(seed) streams per row; matched trial seeds share uniforms across intervention conditions. No repetition penalties.
greedy_retests: Two identical original-strength rows in a 5-row batch and one singleton, compared with the stored original.
notes: No prompt names or requests a riddle.
Each prompt is an independent single-turn native chat.
Positive and half-strength controls probe direction and dose; this is not a complete specificity study.
